from.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|audio=BrightCenter.flac|{{Film|IV}}}} '''Tatooine''' (pronounced /tætu'in/; [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]]: ''Tah doo Een e''''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]'') was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world and the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Binary star system/Legends|binary]] [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. It was part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was inhabited by poor locals who mostly [[Moisture farm/Legends|farmed moisture]] for a living. Other activities included used equipment retailing and scrap dealing[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 1|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 1]]. The planet was on the [[5709-DC Shipping Lane]], a spur of the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which itself connected to the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. The planet was not far from the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. It had its own [[Tatooine navigation system|navigation system]]. The planet acquired a bad reputation, often being viewed as the cesspool of the galaxy due to the large number of criminals who could be found there. However, it would nevertheless play a role in major galactic events throughout the millennia, most notably being the homeworld of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. It was here that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] recognized Anakin's potential to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and where he introduced him to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his future master and mentor. Tatooine was also the home of Anakin's son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]], where he lived until his early adulthood. ==Description== ===Geology=== {{Quote|What a desolate place this is.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|}} Tatooine was thought to have been one of the oldest planets in known space and was composed of a molten core with a rocky mantle and silicate rock crust. Other notable geological features included the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], an enormous [[Sodium/Legends|sodium]]-rich desert; [[Mushroom Mesa/Legends|Mushroom Mesa]], a vast formation of giant standing stones; and the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], a rocky region. There was a settlers' saying that one's eyes burn out faster by staring straight and hard at sun-scorched flatlands than by looking directly at the suns.[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]] ===Climate=== {{Quote|There's nothing to see. I used to live here, you know.|Luke Skywalker|}} [[File:Tatooine3.png|thumb|left|150px|Tatooine's twin suns [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]] setting over the sand dunes]] Tatooine orbited two suns, [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]], and was covered in deserts and rock formations, so the days were extremely arid and bright, especially during [[double noon]]. In fact, it was so brightly lit by the suns that from space it could appear to be a star itself. This was the case for the people who discovered Tatooine as they first thought Tatooine was in fact a star until they approached and discovered that it was a desert planet. The planet circled the suns far enough to develop a stable, but very hot, climate. Due to the extreme conditions, only a relatively mild region of its northern hemisphere was habitable, and less than 1% of the planet was covered in surface water. The average humidity level was 5.4%. One of the many extraordinary features unique to Tatooine was the mysterious mists, which rose regularly from the ground where desert sands met cliffs and mesas. Various theories of this moisture's origin were disputed by meteorologists and geologists, like water suspended in [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]] veins beneath the sand and complex chemical reactions which made it rise when the ground cooled, then fall underground again with the double sunrise. ==History== {{Quote|Back on Tatooine—for such a desolate, backwater world, it has assumed a great deal of importance for the rest of the galaxy.|Boba Fett|''[[Hard Merchandise]]''}} ===Infinite Empire=== [[File:LushTatooine-DotJ1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tatooine, once a lush and thriving world]] Tatooine was once a green world''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' with oceans and cities that were inhabited by the technologically advanced [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]]. They traveled into space, drawing the attention of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. In [[25,783 BBY|25,793 BBY]], the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquered]] the planet, enslaved the Kumumgah, and abducted many of them to their other conquered worlds. After a terrible plague weakened the Rakata, the Kumumgah eventually [[Bombardment of Tatooine|rebelled]] and managed to drive the Rakata off the planet. In response they subjected the planet to an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that "glassed" (that is, fused the [[Silica/Legends|silica]] in the soil into glass, which then broke up over time into sand) the planet and boiled its oceans away. [[HK-47]] speculated that the Kumumgah's excessive production started this drastic climatic change before the Rakata arrived. Over time, the Kumumgah split into two races:[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']] the Ghorfas, who would become{{StoryCite|story=The Lost City of Tatooine|book=Wikipedia:Dig_(magazine)|bformatted=''Archaeology's Dig'' July 1999}} the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], and the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. ===Old Republic=== ====Early years==== {{Quote|Companies pull out, cities dry up, and in a few years, someone who doesn't know why it failed, tries again.|A sandcrawler engineer talking about [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], [[3956 BBY]]|}} Fierce [[Battles above Tatooine|battles]] occurred in the skies above the planet around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The fights scattered the surface of wrecks that quickly disappeared under the sands. Tatooine was first settled by miners around [[4200 BBY]]. They established a village that would become [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sidrona Diath]] and his son [[Dace Diath|Dace]] arrived on the planet. Dace Diath spent the majority of his early life on Tatooine being taught his initial [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] by his father.''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' During the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], the Jedi [[Cleansing of Tatooine|cleansed]] the planet of [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]].{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}} At the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet was practically controlled by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. They were attempting to mine ores from Tatooine, although they soon discovered the ores had strange magnetic properties which made the metal corrode very fast and thus useless for production. Later, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] came to Tatooine during his quest to locate the [[Star Forge]], via the [[Star Map]]s, as there was one on Tatooine. He discovered that Czerka Corporation was attempting to eradicate a nearby tribe of Sand People due to attacks on Czerka's [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]]. With the help of the recently purchased droid [[HK-47]], Revan was able to communicate with the tribe and negotiate a truce after infiltrating their settlement. It was revealed to Revan that the Sand people considered the Czerka to be invaders on their land, which was the reason for the frequent attacks. Revan later learned the history of the Sand People from the tribe's history keeper, by giving a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|pearl]] to the chieftain. ====Lost and found again==== {{Quote|I know little about Tatooine, other than that the planet was heir to an ecological catastrophe in the dim past, and that its vast deserts now support a population of ne'er-do-wells, scoundrels, and hapless spacers of all species. I've heard it said that nothing pans out on Tatooine, and that beings who reside there age prematurely.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]|[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]}} [[File:TatooineMap-TheWorldOfSWKenobi.png|thumb|left|200px|A map of Tatooine]] In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the Hutts took control of Tatooine, seeing it as an important transfer point between the Triellus and the Corellian Run. ====Rise of the Empire==== {{Quote|You can't take her Royal Highness there! The Hutts are gangsters! If they discovered her…!''"
"''It would be no different than if we landed on a system controlled by the Federation, except that the Hutts aren't looking for her, which gives us the advantage.|Captain [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|{{Film|I}}}} In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] and her son [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] took refuge from [[Pirate/Legends|Space Pirates]] on Tatooine, only to be [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] in [[Imperial Station Bravo|her palace]].
[[File:Mos_Espa_2.png|thumb|left|250px|Mos Espa]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her companions, including the Jedi [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], arrived on Tatooine in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] after escaping the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|capture]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They talked about how to repair the [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|hyperdrive]] of her [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|starship]]. They couldn't pay for it in the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|currency]] that the dealer with the replacement, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], [[Druggat/Legends|wanted]]. [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] landed on Tatooine with his [[Scimitar/Legends|Scimitar]] after being sent by his master [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to locate, spy on and destroy the two Jedi as well as the Queen; Maul sent [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|Sith Probe Droids]] to both [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and its sister city [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. It was on the world at the time that the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] first met. Anakin Skywalker, one of Watto's slaves, decided to enter the upcoming [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]], the famous [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], and use his winnings to pay for the hyperdrive. He became a local legend in Mos Espa by being the first Human ever to win a podrace. After winning the race, Qui-Gon, Padmé, Anakin, R2-D2, C-3PO and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] returned to the cruiser after narrowly escaping an [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|assassination]] attempt by Darth Maul. During their departure from the world, Qui-Gon introduced Anakin to Obi-Wan and took him to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for him to join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].{{Film|I}} Watto eventually lost his [[Wald's Parts|shop]]. In late 32 BBY, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] came to Tatooine and, on behalf of Jabba, disposed of Gardulla and subsequently her empire, giving Jabba a virtual monopoly on the rule of Tatooine's criminal underworld.''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' However, Jabba's monopoly was eventually challenged by [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] crime queen Lady [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] gave birth to his son [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]. [[File:Mos_Espa_Grand_Arena.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] was a famous Podracing track on Tatooine.]] In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Anakin Skywalker, sensing his mother, Shmi Skywalker, was in terrible pain, returned to Tatooine with Padmé from Naboo. He was roughly informed of her location by his newly introduced stepfather [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], who had been temporally crippled trying to save her from [[Tusken Raider/Legends|her captors]]. On his way to the Tusken village, the tribes's location was specified by a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] chieftain in their [[Jawa camp|camp]]. When Anakin arrived he found that Shmi had been tortured by the Tusken Raiders and later died in his arms. Enraged, Anakin brutally [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|massacred]] the entire Tusken Raider [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|tribe]]. Anakin had a funeral for Shmi, with Padmé, his step family, R2-D2 and C-3PO. Later he left Tatooine with Padmé and the droids to [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|rescue]] Obi-Wan on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]; this ultimately began the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].{{Film|II}} Cliegg died shortly thereafter from his injury and a broken heart, leaving [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru]] to watch over the Lars homestead. During the Clone Wars, the Republic tried to re-establish a presence on the world by constructing a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] spaceport, but Confederacy General [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]], allied with the minor Hutt crime lord [[Boorka]], wiped it out and established her own fortress. Jabba protested Boorka's direct involvement in the Clone Wars, and betrayed the fortress's location to [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], who wiped it out. In truth, helping Echuu was simply Jabba's way of eliminating Boorka, since Jabba himself got directly involved in the Clone Wars:''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'' he shipped [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] ore through Tatooine to [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] for the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] to build [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|cortosis droids]]. This operation was ended by Anakin Skywalker.''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]'' Sometime before or during 19 BBY, [[X1]] and [[X2]] formed a garrison here with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ferroda]]. However the CIS came shortly after they arrived but the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] garrison [[Invasion of Tatooine|held them off]] successfully and X1 and X2 were awarded medals for their efforts.''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first year of the war, Anakin, with his [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|apprentice]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], was reluctant to [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|return]] to Tatooine, via the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], due to Jabba allowing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] access to the secret Hutt [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperlanes]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] for [[Battle of Teth/Legends|rescuing]] his son Rotta on the [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] [[B'omarr Monastery|Monastery]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] emerged victorious at delivering Rotta to Jabba's Palace, despite sabotage from [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]]. Thus [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's Empire]], and subsequently the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], became an ally of the Republic, and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] was allowed safe passage through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]. Later during that year, Jabba sent [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|free]] his [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|uncle]] from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on Coruscant. Ziro was then imprisoned in [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] said he was to collect the bounty of Ziro for betraying him. The targeted Hutt was freed by his girlfriend [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] and taken to Teth where he visited his [[Papa/Legends|father's]] [[Tomb of Ziro the Hutt's father/Legends|hidden grave]]. Cad followed to kill him there but Sy beaten him to it and collected her reward in Jabba's Palace.{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}

The Pantorans [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] and [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion Papanoida]] traveled to the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] on [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on Tatooine, whom Greedo was employed by. Papanoida was able to draw the Rodian out by simply telling a female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] that they were looking for him. As expected, [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] came to the Pantorans and attempted to get rid of them, only for Papanoida to pull out a knife and hold it against Greedo's throat. Matters were brought before Jabba, whom Papanoida managed to reason with into assisting them, by comparing Greedo's blood to the sample he found on Coruscant. No sooner that Jabba permitted it did Greedo spill that he had Chi Eekway held in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The Pantorans forced Greedo to lead them to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] where Eekway was being held. But things got tense, as Greedo's [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] partner began to question him. The Rodian turned on the Pantorans and fled the cantina, as all the patrons started firing on them. The Pantorans were able to dispatch all the assailants; Eekway even saved her father's life by shooting the Gotal when he attempted to kill Papanoida when his back was turned. The Pantorans returned to Coruscant as Chuchi and Tano rescued Che Amanwe from the battleship. Because the Federation lacked leverage, they were forced to end the [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|Blockade of Pantora]].{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}} In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] after the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] traveled to Tatooine and Chalmun's Cantina killed [[Oked/Legends|Oked]] and became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] with [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] and [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] to travel [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] for [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|Bounty]].{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}} After taking the bounty back to Tatooine, Ventress was sitting in a cantina with Latts when she reacted to the door suddenly opening by gripping her lightsaber. When Latts questioned her reaction, Ventress told her that she had thought that she sensed someone from her past. Sometime after his victory over [[Darth Krayt]], [[Cade Skywalker]] landed on the planet as a fugitive.[[Legacy (2006) 37|''Legacy'' (2006) 37]] ==Inhabitants== [[File:Hanchewiesandstormtatooine.jpg|thumb|left|175px|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] seek shelter during one of Tatooine's sandstorms.]] {{Quote|Be careful, Ion, the Hutts are the only law that matters on Tatooine.|Baron Papanoida to his son|}} The inhabitants of Tatooine included many different species from many parts of the galaxy, as can be seen in the multiple bars and cantinas in the cities. Most creatures on the planet loved to gamble on nearly everything, especially [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]], though the sport declined after the rise of the Empire. This may attest to the fact that the planet has long been controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Human natives of the planet often had unusual sounding last names, such as Fardreamer, Sandskimmer, Darklighter, and Skywalker. ==Behind the scenes== Tatooine is frequently misspelled as "Tattoine" in some sources. This should be interpreted as a typing error. The planet is not actually named in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], although it's named in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] and [[Star Wars (1977) 1|comic]] [[Star Wars (1977) 2|adaptation]].[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]][[Star Wars (1977) 2|''Star Wars'' (1977) 2]] [[George Lucas]] called it [[Utapau (Kessil system)|Utapau]] in all but the [[The Star Wars first draft|first draft]] of the script, then renamed it in the fourth after the movie's desert location, [[Wikipedia:Tataouine|Tataouine]] (French spelling) in Tunisia (see also [[Tunisia]] for other Tunisian-inspired names).''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]'' Tatooine has appeared in every ''Star Wars'' film in the Legends continuity except [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], where it was only mentioned by name. In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] the planet appears only in the closing shot on the Lars moisture farm. [[File:Tatooine_TEA.jpg|thumb|200px|Tatooine as depicted in ''The Essential Atlas'']] On September 15, 2011, a planet (actually a Saturn-like gas giant) in the real universe was discovered with two suns. The official name is Kepler-16b, but many call it the real Tatooine. (Even NASA is calling it a "Tatooine-like" planet.) A Lucasfilm employee was present at NASA's news conference. Kepler-16b is 200 light years from Earth in the constellation Cygnus (the swan). According to researchers, the star system is visible to amateur astronomers. The planet was discovered a day before the release of the ''Star Wars'' Blu-rays in North America. As of 11 January 2012, two more gas giants that orbit two suns each have been found. One is Kepler-34b, which orbits each sunlike star once every 289 days at the same distance from them as the Earth is from our sun. Kepler-34b is located 4900 light years away from Earth. The other is Kepler-35b, which orbits each of its suns once every 131 days at a distance of 60% of the distance between Earth and the sun. Kepler-35b's suns are smaller than our sun and are located 5400 light years from Earth. Tatooine could also be taken as a derivative of the planet [[Wikipedia:Mongo (planet)|Mongo]] of [[Wikipedia:Flash Gordon|Flash Gordon]], which is presented as a desert planet in some media. This is strongly supported by the presence of the starport [[Gordon]] on the planet [[Aquilae (The Star Wars)|Aquilae]] in the [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]], the same planet which was later named Utapau in the [[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|second draft]], where Gordon is briefly mentioned. Utapau, as noted above, was renamed Tatooine. Additionally, [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] attempted to create a [[Mongo Beefhead Tribesman]] action figure for ''[[The Epic Continues]]'', further strengthening the Mongo/Flash Gordon connection; however, the [[1986]] toy line was canceled before making it to production.{{GalaxyCite|2|Galactic Bazaar|Galactic Bazaar: Tales of Phantom Toys}} In [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], the map of Tatooine is actually a map of [[Wikipedia:Mars|Mars]]. In the ''Star Wars'' universe, planet names ending in "-ooine" are quite common; examples include [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]], [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] and [[Vactooine]]. This is similar to the "-stan" suffix of many nations in Asia.
